text:
deploy-bot: Alert: elevated 5xxs from eu-west during region flip to green variant (inference-proxy). AlertID INC-2026-4882. Metric: proxy_5xx_rate > 7% for 3m.

maria (oncall): I'm paged. joining. can someone confirm scope (traffic %, models affected)?

jordan: seeing ~28% of eu-west traffic routed to green (flag evaluation mismatch). 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate proxied to green-hosts. logs show KV cache misses + upstream 502 consistently.

kevin: spawning rollback job for eu-west green targets. will also try flag kill if rollback not complete in 2m.

sam: copying observed errors — snippet from proxy logs: ```[2026-04-12T09:12:03Z] upstream 502 "empty-kv-cache" host=green-03-eu-west```. also hits look like HTTP 502 -> client.

lina: customer impact? any top clients affected or just internal probes?

jordan: quick check: overall global error bump negligible but eu-west client-visible error rate ~0.9%. small set of heavy customers (acme-corp and goodco) saw intermittent failures for 10-15 minutes.

k evin: kickstarted rollback: `/infra/deploy rollback --region eu-west --deploy-id green-2026-04-12-09 --force` — job id roll-eu-0007. status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Rollback job roll-eu-0007 started by kevin (releng). ETA ~90s per shard.

maria (oncall): handing off pager to jordan while I grab logs and start RCA notes. jordan, you're primary until ops-bot clears. @sam can you open an incident timeline doc?

jordan: on it. also initiating flag kill as safety mechanism if rollback stalls: ```POST /api/flags/green-flip/abort?region=eu-west``` — will mark as immediate kill.

ops-bot: Kill-switch executed by jordan at 09:14:05Z. Flag state -> ABORTED, routing snapped to blue.

kevin: rollback finished on 6/6 shards. monitoring for error tail. proxy_5xx_rate dropping to baseline (0.6%).

lina: notified affected accounts (acme-corp) in #customers-notify. message: "We've detected partial failures during a regional deployment in eu-west. We've reverted the deployment and are monitoring; follow-up incoming."

sam: incident doc created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4882 — timeline + customer impact added. paging log included. will schedule postmortem.

maria (oncall): thanks. handing oncall back to me in 10m for follow-up. jordan, can you collect `strace` logs from green-hosts and archive kv-cache stats? put artifacts in the incident doc.

jordan: grabbing artifacts now. quick grep shows TTL on route entries were 30s on edge, but some resolvers returned stale CNAME causing 20% of probes to still reach old green IPs during the flip. `/net/dns-cache/dump` attached to incident doc.

kevin: follow-up actions: 1) add preflip TTL scrub step in rollout orchestrator, 2) add an early kill-flag webhook if backend 5xx > 5% for 2m, 3) run canary traffic drift test in staging.

lina: +1 on customer follow-up scheduled for 2 hours. ops to prepare a short RCA with timeline and mitigation steps.

maria (oncall): incident resolved for paging. monitoring for 30m. if error rate reappears, re-open and escalate. great quick moves from everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4882 marked RESOLVED by maria (oncall) at 09:20:45Z. Postmortem owner: jordan.

jordan: adding notes and artifacts now — will share draft PM within 24h.
